# Specifies the base image. Ubuntu 22.04 is a stable, recent LTS release.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set a non-interactive frontend for package managers to avoid prompts during the build.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, libraries, and certificates.
# - build-essential, gfortran, cmake: Core compilation toolchain.
# - git: For cloning the application source code from a repository.
# - python3: Added as it is a required dependency for the LAMMPS build system.
# - ca-certificates: Required for secure network communications (e.g., HTTPS for git).
# - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: OpenMPI for parallel processing support.
# - libfftw3-dev: A common dependency for LAMMPS for Fast Fourier Transforms.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    cmake \
    git \
    python3 \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libfftw3-dev && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments.
# These settings allow running as root and improve network compatibility inside containers.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_exclude=lo,docker0

# Define the working directory for the application.
WORKDIR /app

# Clone, configure, build, and install LAMMPS in a single RUN layer.
# - Clones the latest branch of the LAMMPS source code.
# - Copies the required reaxff/HNS example files to the WORKDIR.
# - Configures the build using CMake, enabling MPI and the REAXFF package.
#   PKG_MOLECULE and PKG_KSPACE are common dependencies for REAXFF.
# - Compiles the source code using all available CPU cores.
# - Installs the compiled binaries to /usr/local/, placing `lmp` on the system PATH.
# - Cleans up the source code directory to reduce final image size.
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /tmp/lammps && \
    cp /tmp/lammps/examples/reaxff/HNS/* . && \
    mkdir /tmp/lammps/build && \
    cd /tmp/lammps/build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
        -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local \
        -D BUILD_MPI=yes \
        -D PKG_MOLECULE=yes \
        -D PKG_KSPACE=yes \
        -D PKG_REAXFF=yes && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    rm -rf /tmp/lammps

# Ensure the directory containing the LAMMPS executable is in the PATH.
# While /usr/local/bin is typically in the default PATH, this makes it explicit.
ENV PATH="/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"

# Set a default command to provide a shell, which can be overridden at runtime.
# e.g., `docker run <image_name> lmp -in in.hns`
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

flux-minicluster-manifest.item:
# This MiniCluster manifest is designed to deploy a single-pod (single-node)
# LAMMPS HPC job using the Flux Operator on Kubernetes.
# It is configured for an AWS CPU environment.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster resource.
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  # Deploying to the 'default' namespace as per instructions.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The size of the cluster in pods. Set to 1 for a single-node run.
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI tasks for the job.
  # The Flux Operator will execute 'flux run -n 1 ...' with the command below.
  tasks: 1

  # Logging mode: 'strict' will cause the job to fail on any container error.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Do not delete the pods and services upon job completion.
  # This is useful for debugging and inspecting logs or output files.
  cleanup: false

  # Pod specifications for the MiniCluster. Only one container is defined as requested.
  containers:
    - # The specific container image for the LAMMPS experiment.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax

      # The application command to be executed by Flux.
      # The Flux Operator automatically prepends 'flux run -n <tasks>' to this command.
      # We assume 'lmp' is in the container's PATH as per best practices.
      command: lmp -v x 4 -v y 4 -v z 4 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite

      # Explicitly setting launcher to false as required.
      # In a single-container MiniCluster, that container is implicitly the launcher.
      launcher: false

      # No resource requests or limits are set.
      # This results in a 'Burstable' QoS class, allowing the pod to
      # utilize all available CPU and memory on the node if needed.

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  namespace: default
spec:
  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: lmp -v x 4 -v y 4 -v z 4 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
    launcher: false
  flux:
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  logging:
    strict: true
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: hpc7g.16xlarge
  size: 1
  tasks: 64

context.details:

You MUST put lmp on the PATH.
